transcript: I think my ideal societies actually were the science-based ones and sustainability, but I think the biggest issue is grouping people, large amounts of people into one common theme and idea. It never goes well or as well as planned. A type of future that I feel myself missing is one of multiple options. for people to decide if they want to choose faith-based, if they want to choose AI, if they want to choose sustainability. I think the biggest thing when it comes to an ideal future scenario is putting people where they want to be and not forcing a large group of people that will likely not all agree and all be accommodating of the situation into one area.
